title: Part 4 Practice: Natural Vegetation of Ethiopia

questions.text: Which vegetation region in Ethiopia is found above 3,200 meters altitude?
questions.explanation: Correct: Afro-alpine region is found above 3,200m. A is wrong—forest region is 1,500-3,000m. B is wrong—woodland savannah is 500-1,500m. D is wrong—steppe is 500-1,000m.

questions.text: The giant lobelia (Lobelia rhynchopetalum) is found in which Ethiopian vegetation region?
questions.explanation: Correct: Giant lobelia is endemic to the afro-alpine region. A is wrong—semi-desert has drought-tolerant species. B is wrong—forest has trees like Podocarpus. D is wrong—woodland savannah has Acacia species.

questions.text: Which vegetation region is characterized by Podocarpus falcatus and Juniperus procera as dominant species?
questions.explanation: Correct: Podocarpus and Juniperus are dominant in forest region. A is wrong—steppe has grasses. C is wrong—semi-desert has Acacia and Aloe. D is wrong—afro-alpine has Lobelia and Erica.

questions.text: The Simien Mountains National Park primarily protects which vegetation type?
questions.explanation: Correct: Simien Mountains protect afro-alpine vegetation. A is wrong—semi-desert is in lowlands. B is wrong—forest is at lower altitudes. D is wrong—woodland savannah is in lowlands.

questions.text: Which of the following is a cause of natural vegetation degradation in Ethiopia?
questions.explanation: Correct: Deforestation is a major cause of vegetation degradation. A is wrong—afforestation is conservation. C is wrong—reforestation is restoration. D is wrong—agroforestry is conservation.

questions.text: The Afro-alpine region is found on which of the following mountains?
questions.explanation: Correct: Simien Mountains have afro-alpine vegetation. B is wrong—Kilimanjaro is in Tanzania. C is wrong—Mount Kenya is in Kenya. D is wrong—Rwenzori is in Uganda.

questions.text: In which vegetation region would you find Acacia and Combretum as dominant tree species?
questions.explanation: Correct: Acacia and Combretum are dominant in woodland savannah. A is wrong—afro-alpine has Lobelia. B is wrong—forest has Podocarpus. D is wrong—semi-desert has drought-tolerant species.

questions.text: What percentage of Ethiopia's forests were lost in the last century?
questions.explanation: Correct: Ethiopia lost about 90% of its forests in the last century. A is wrong—too low. B is wrong—still too low. D is wrong—slightly high, though severe.

questions.text: Which of the following is a conservation strategy for natural vegetation in Ethiopia?
questions.explanation: Correct: National Parks protect vegetation. A is wrong—deforestation degrades vegetation. B is wrong—overgrazing degrades vegetation. D is wrong—burning degrades vegetation.

questions.text: The Ethiopian Green Legacy Initiative contributes to vegetation conservation through:
questions.explanation: Correct: Green Legacy is a massive tree-planting campaign. A is wrong—roads degrade forests. C is wrong—agriculture expansion degrades vegetation. D is wrong—dams are not the primary focus.
